description: This Java class `DefaultTimerBuilder` constructs and configures a `PreparedTimer` object, ensuring it is started upon creation. It provides methods to add custom tags to the timer and a method to build and retrieve the timer instance.

classes.name: DefaultTimerBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating PreparedTimer instances with specified tags, starting the timer immediately upon creation.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer, overriding existing tags with the same key.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single key-value pair tag to the timer, overriding any existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a PreparedTimer object with the specified tags.
